title: Kim2025 – 40-class beta-range SSVEP speller dataset
description: A 40-class SSVEP speller EEG dataset recorded from 40 healthy participants using beta-range flicker frequencies (14.0-21.8 Hz, 0.2 Hz spacing). Stimuli were presented with the joint frequency-phase modulation (JFPM) approach in a 5x8 matrix on a 120 Hz monitor. Each participant completed six blocks of 40 trials with 33-channel BioSemi recordings at 1024 Hz. The dataset is intended for developing low-visual-fatigue SSVEP-based brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: 33-channel EEG (31 scalp and 2 mastoid) was recorded with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 1024 Hz. Each trial had 1.5 s rest, 0.5 s cue and 5.0 s SSVEP stimulation using JFPM flicker with 0.5*pi phase differences between adjacent stimuli. Participants completed 6 blocks of 40 trials on a 5x8 speller matrix shown on a 120 Hz monitor. Epochs span -2 to 5 s relative to stimulus onset.
